s.n: Tong Po's crying tiger beef with jaew
s.note: Tong Po the Tiger kicks the concrete pillar. Charred rump, smoky chilli and lime dip.
s.how: Rub the steak with the soy, oyster sauce and half the sugar and leave for 15 minutes. Toast the rice in a dry pan until deep golden, then grind it to a coarse powder. For the jaew, mix the fish sauce, juice of 2 limes, the rest of the sugar, chilli flakes, shallots and a spoon of the ground rice. Grill the steak over high heat until charred outside and pink inside, then rest it for 5 minutes. Slice thinly, scatter with herbs and the rest of the rice powder, and serve with lettuce cups, lime wedges and the jaew.

s.note: Kurt kicks the banana tree down. Banana blossom, prawns, chilli jam, coconut.
s.how: Peel off the tough outer layers of the blossom, slice the pale heart very thinly and drop it into water with the juice of a lime. Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden. Whisk the chilli jam, fish sauce, sugar, coconut cream and the juice of the other lime. Drain the blossom well and toss with the prawns, dressing and herbs. Pile onto a plate and finish with the peanuts and toasted coconut.

m.n: Pedicab pad kra pao with a crisp fried egg
m.note: Now you drive me in Pedicab. Chilli pork, holy basil, jasmine rice.
m.how: Rinse the rice and cook it with 3 cups of water, covered, then rest it off the heat. Pound the garlic and chillies to a rough paste. Fry the paste in the oil in a smoking wok for 30 seconds, add the pork and stir-fry until browned and catching. Add the oyster, fish and soy sauces and the sugar, toss, then wilt in the basil. Fry the eggs in hot oil, spooning it over until the edges are crisp and the yolks still soft, and serve on the rice and pork.

m.n: White warrior green curry of chicken
m.note: The crowd chants Nack Suk Cao. Thigh, Thai eggplant, basil, coconut.
m.how: Put the rice on to cook. Boil the coconut cream in a wok until it splits and the oil shows, then fry the curry paste in it until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir to coat, then add the coconut milk, eggplant and lime leaves and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Season with the fish sauce and sugar, stir in the basil and top with the chilli. Serve with the rice.
shop: 6 Thai eggplants, quartered (or 1 small eggplant, diced)@Produce

w.n: Mango sticky rice with smashed palm sugar glass
w.note: Hemp rope, resin and broken glass. Coconut sticky rice, mango, shards of toffee.
w.how: Drain the rice and steam it in a lined steamer until tender and sticky. Meanwhile warm 300ml coconut milk with the 100g sugar and the salt, pour most of it over the hot rice, cover and leave to soak in. Melt the 150g sugar in a dry pan until amber, pour thinly onto baking paper, scatter with sesame and leave to set hard, then smash into shards. Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with the cornflour until thick for the topping. Serve the rice with sliced mango, the thick coconut and shards of glass stuck in the top.
shop: 100g caster sugar, plus 150g for the glass@Pantry

d.n: Mekhong bucket with lime and soda
d.note: Xian gets Kurt drunk before the bar fight. Thai spirit, lime, Red Bull, soda, ice.
d.how: Squeeze the lime wedges into a small ice bucket or large jug and drop them in. Fill with ice, pour in the Mekhong and Red Bull and top with soda. Stir and serve with a straw each.
